verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical, and both lose the brand: the olive block behind the headline is gone, and the olive panels are reduced to two small, meaningless rectangles at the bottom. Both also set the attribution in bold at almost the headline's size, so the hierarchy is weak, and the thin white frame floats over the steeple with no clear purpose. A is slightly better balanced. B leaves extra dead space at the top and pushes its olive rectangles almost against the bottom edge.
